title.narrative: For the Project: Preventing Drowning in Artisanal Fishing Communities of Lake

description.narrative: The ‘Preventing drowning in artisanal fishing communities in Lake Victoria, Tanzania’ project aims to reduce drowning in artisanal fishing communities around Lake Victoria, together with the implementing partner Environmental Management and Economic Development Organization. The objective is to teach drowning prevention skills to fishers and fish processors, enhance drowning prevention in community-led governance structures, train selected individuals within these groups to act as trainers, and share progress on drowning prevention at local level and raise awareness. The key activities include gender sensitive and community-oriented, effective drowning prevention training; safe fisheries plans are piloted and implemented using an inclusive community design process; drowning prevention district strategies co-designed, piloted, evaluated and implemented; and influencing strategy guides engagement with national stakeholders on drowning prevention policies.
